def test_daily_image_limit_message_is_localized(conn, lumen, user_id):
    for i in range(5):
        generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", f"req-{i}")

def test_pro_images_are_unlimited(conn, lumen, pro_user_id):
    for i in range(7):
        assert generate_image(conn, lumen, pro_user_id, "a cat", f"req-{i}")["ok"]
    assert len(lumen.calls) == 7


def test_daily_image_limit_resets_at_utc_midnight(conn, lumen, user_id):
    for i in range(5):
        generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", f"req-{i}")
    clock.set_now(datetime(2026, 3, 1, 23, 59, 59, tzinfo=timezone.utc))
    assert not generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", "req-late")["ok"]
    clock.set_now(datetime(2026, 3, 2, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc))
    assert generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", "req-next")["ok"]

        generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", "req-1")
    assert quota.used(conn, user_id, "image") == 1


def test_provider_error_releases_quota(conn, lumen, user_id):
    lumen.fail_with = LumenAPIError(500, "internal", "boom")
    assert generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", "req-0")["error_code"] == "provider_failed"

    assert generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", "req-0")["error_code"] == "content_filtered"
    assert quota.used(conn, user_id, "image") == 0


def test_insufficient_credits_releases_quota(conn, lumen):

    assert quota.used(conn, poor, "image") == 0
